seo.title: Shopify AI chatbot for WhatsApp, Instagram and your store | Steps AI
seo.description: Connect Shopify to Steps AI. Answer order questions, recommend products, add to cart and check out in the chat, and recover carts with ready-made workflows.

hero.title: Answer order questions and sell in the chat with Shopify.
hero.body: Your agent checks real orders, stock and discounts in your Shopify store before it replies. Customers can choose a product, add it to a cart and check out without leaving the conversation.
hero.reassurance: Live store data. Checkout on your own Shopify checkout. Workflows ready to switch on.

lines.text: Your order 1042 was shipped yesterday and is on its way to you.
Great. Do you have the linen shirt in medium as well?
Yes, medium is in stock. Shall I add it to your cart?

useCases.title: What you can do with Shopify connected.
useCases.intro: Each one uses live data from your store, so the agent answers from what is true right now.

items.title: Answer where is my order
items.body: The agent finds the order in Shopify and replies with its current status, on any channel the customer uses.

items.title: Recommend from your catalogue
items.body: Suggestions come only from products in your store, and the agent leaves out anything that is out of stock.

items.title: Add to cart and check out in the chat
items.body: Customers pick a size or colour, add items to a cart in the chat and get a checkout message. They can come back and finish the checkout later.

items.title: Mention only your active discounts
items.body: Your Shopify discounts and promotions are synced to Steps AI, so the agent can tell customers about offers that are live and nothing else.

items.title: Recover abandoned carts and checkouts
items.body: Switch on a ready-made workflow to follow up on WhatsApp, email or the website widget when a customer leaves without paying.

items.title: Reconfirm cash-on-delivery orders
items.body: Ask COD customers to confirm before you ship, and send a payment link if they would rather pay now.

items.title: See revenue from conversations
items.body: Paid Shopify orders are linked back to the WhatsApp campaign or agent conversation that led to them.

walkthrough.title: From a product question to a paid order.
walkthrough.intro: A typical conversation on WhatsApp when a customer is ready to buy.

steps.label: Recommend a product
steps.customer: I need a shirt for a summer wedding. Something light.
steps.agent: The linen shirt in sand is a good fit and it is one of our lightest fabrics. Would you like to see it?
steps.note: The agent picks from products in your Shopify catalogue.

steps.label: Check stock and size
steps.customer: Yes. Do you have it in medium?
steps.agent: Medium is in stock. I have added it to your cart.
steps.note: Stock comes from Shopify, so the agent does not offer a size you cannot ship.

steps.label: Share a live offer
steps.agent: Yes, SUMMER10 gives you 10% off this week. It is applied at checkout.
steps.note: Only discounts synced from your store are mentioned.

steps.label: Check out in the chat
steps.agent: Here is your checkout. Tap to pay on our secure checkout page.
steps.note: Payment happens on your Shopify checkout. Steps AI does not take payments.

workflows.title: Ready-made Shopify workflows.
workflows.intro: Pick a template, check the wording and switch it on. Each one runs on events from your store.

items.title: Recover abandoned carts
items.body: Follow up with shoppers who added items but did not check out, on the website widget, by email or on WhatsApp.

items.title: Follow up on unfinished checkouts
items.body: Remind customers who started a checkout, with a one or two step email sequence.

items.title: Confirm orders and send updates
items.body: Send an order confirmation, then a shipping update and a review request after delivery.

items.title: Reconfirm cash-on-delivery orders
items.body: Check that COD customers still want the order before it ships, and offer a payment link to switch to prepaid.

items.title: Win back cancelled and quiet customers
items.body: Reach customers who cancelled an order, or who have not bought in a while, with a message and a discount code you choose.

items.title: Alert your team about big orders
items.body: Notify your team when an order is above the value you set, or when a refund comes in.

setup.title: Connect Shopify in a few minutes.
setup.intro: No code. You sign in to the app once and you choose which agents use it.

items.title: Connect Shopify
items.body: Open Resources, then Apps, and choose Shopify. Sign in, or enter your account details, to connect it to your workspace.

items.title: Add it to your agent
items.body: Connecting adds Shopify to your workspace. Then add it to each agent that should use it. An agent only uses the app once both steps are done.

items.title: Choose what the agent can do
items.body: Your products are indexed and your discounts imported. Then switch on the shopping features and any workflows you want.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: Customers pay on your own Shopify checkout. Steps AI does not process payments.
Cart and checkout in the chat work on the website widget, WhatsApp and Instagram.
Workflow messages on WhatsApp use templates approved by Meta.

items.q: Can the agent see my orders?
items.a: Yes. Once Shopify is connected and switched on, the agent can look up an order and share its status with the customer it belongs to.

items.q: Will it recommend products that are out of stock?
items.a: No. The agent checks stock in Shopify and does not show products with zero or negative stock.

items.q: Can customers pay inside the chat?
items.a: Customers build a cart in the chat and then pay on your Shopify checkout page. A checkout can be resumed later.

items.q: Does it work with my discount codes?
items.a: Yes. Discounts and promotions are imported from Shopify and kept up to date, and the agent only mentions the ones that are active.

items.q: Can I see which sales came from the agent?
items.a: Paid Shopify orders are attributed to WhatsApp campaigns and agent conversations, so you can see the revenue each one brought in.
